messages:
mia: Heads-up: third-party pen test scheduled for staging next Tue. They need KMS Encrypt/Decrypt on one test key + assume-role for API calls. Proposing 2.5h window 10:30-13:00 PDT. Any red flags?

owen: Fine. Let's scope to a single test key and ephemeral creds. Deny key policy changes and rotations during the window.

lia: I can own ephemeral issuance. Recommend 1h TTL per session and an IP allowlist for the vendor. Will also prepare an obs checklist.

infra: We'll add a small terraform change: role + IP whitelist + read-only trail viewer. Example assume-role CLI to provide testers. PR will be tagged "pt-access".

ops-bot: automated: scheduled CloudTrail export to s3://audit-hold/pt/1729999000 at 13:10 PDT (immutable 90d).

mia: Evidence list for each finding: CloudTrail event ids (kms and sts), VPC flow logs for tester hosts, app traces (trace ids), request/response captures where possible. Attach to per-finding ticket.

owen: Set CloudWatch alarm: >45 kms:Decrypt calls/min from a single principal -> alert. Pager duty only for critical spikes. Medium+low goes to triage board.

lia: Retest expectation: vendor will re-run targeted findings within 4 business days after fix verification; reserve up to 2h per retest. Keep same key/role for parity.

mia: Quick action items:
- infra: terraform role + IP whitelist + viewer role (PR by Fri)
- lia: obs checklist + repro template (Wed)
- ops-bot/ops: confirm export & immutability (Wed)
- owen: triage board + ticket template (Wed)

infra: I'll open the PR and post the link here when ready.

mia: If no objections by EOD tomorrow we lock the window. :thumbsup:
